name: Parameter scalability benchmark
description: Benchmark harness and raw measurement data for the parameter-scalability experiment in the MSc thesis A Novel Type System for Rank-Polymorphic Array Languages (Radboud University, 2026). Measures compiler wall-clock time and peak resident set size as a function of the number of array parameters (0–19), with 10 runs per (compiler, parameter-count) cell. Raw data are in data/param-orig.json and data/param-new.json. Measured on the Radboud University SLURM cluster, node cn99: Intel Xeon E5-2630 v3 @ 2.40 GHz, 4 CPUs and 14 G per task, partition cncz, Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS (kernel 6.17.0-14-generic), gcc 13.3.0. No warmup; each SLURM task is an independent cold run. Wall-clock via date +%s.%N; peak RSS via GNU /usr/bin/time -v. The compiler versions benchmarked are archived separately at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22060662.
